name: What risks are associated with buying an off-market luxury condo?

mainEntity.name: What risks are associated with buying an off-market luxury condo?

acceptedAnswer.text: Risks associated with buying an off-market luxury condo can include potentially limited market exposure, which might mean you are not seeing a full range of comparable properties. There can also be less publicly available information about the property, making due diligence even more critical. A practical tradeoff is that while you gain exclusivity, you must rely heavily on your agent for comprehensive market analysis and property details. Ensuring a thorough inspection and title search is paramount, similar to any property purchase.
acceptedAnswer.description: Risks include limited market exposure and less public information. You rely heavily on your agent for analysis, making due diligence crucial.
